_doc: UNREVIEWED DRAFT — do not consume yet (#1248). Affiliation string -> ROR identifier, generated by scripts/match-ror.mjs. The programme string stays authoritative and is what renders; this is an annotation beside it. null means no confident match, deliberately: do not guess. Auto-accepted at chosen && score >= 0.8, which is a starting point rather than an answer: a high score does not imply correctness. Two errors are already known in the accepted set, and 26 entries in the review tail have a top candidate scoring >= 0.99 that ROR declined to choose, several of which are wrong. Nothing should read this file until the tail in data/ror-candidates.json has been reviewed by a person.
